Interactive Summary｜Gallbladder Neoplasia US

膽囊腫瘤不一定長得像腫瘤
Sessile + Vascularity 是最重要線索

MacLeod et al. 2023：15 例犬貓 gallbladder neoplasia。B-mode appearance 高度多變，無法判斷 histologic type；但所有 discrete masses 都呈 sessile，10/10 可回顧 Doppler studies 均有 vascularity。

8/15neuroendocrine carcinoma
10/10Doppler vascularity
12/15concurrent sludge
4/15initially misdiagnosed
Take-home判讀流程DataPitfallsFiguresClinical use

Take-home Message

Discrete mass

所有可辨識 discrete masses 都是 sessile。

Doppler

有可回顧 Doppler image 的 10/10 全部有 vascularity。

Wall-only tumor

3 cases 沒有 discrete mass，只呈 focal/diffuse wall thickening。

No histology signature

超音波無法可靠區分 NEC、leiomyoma、lymphoma、GIST 等 histologic types。

快速超音波判讀流程

  1. 完整掃描 gallbladder neck、body、fundus/apex。
  2. 任何 fixed、nondependent、tissue-like lesion：先想 true tissue，不只 sludge。
  3. 描述 sessile / pedunculated、focal / diffuse、regular / irregular。
  4. 所有可疑 lesions 做 color 或 power Doppler。
  5. 若只見 wall thickening，也把 neoplasia 放進 differential。
  6. 評估 sludge、choleliths、effusion、steatitis、CBD、regional nodes、hepatic invasion。
  7. 不要依 B-mode 推 histologic type；需要 pathology。

研究資料互動摘要

Diagnosisn
Neuroendocrine carcinoma8
Leiomyoma3
Lymphoma1
Metastatic GIST1
Extrahepatic cholangiocellular carcinoma1
Adenoma1
  • All discrete masses: sessile。
  • 3 cases: wall thickening only, no discrete mass。
  • Neuroendocrine carcinoma can be homogeneous or heterogeneous, mostly hyperechoic but sometimes isoechoic。
  • 10/10 available Doppler studies: vascularity present。
  • Concurrent sludge: 12/15。
  • Cholecystoliths: 1/15。
  • Measured lesions: 0.85–4.5 cm。
  • Median mass size: 1.75 cm。
  • Wall-only lesions: 0.2–1.29 cm thickening。
  • All 4 masses >2 cm in this small cohort were malignant—but this is not a validated cutoff。
  • Both lesions occupying the entire lumen were malignant。
  • 11/14 with partial bloodwork had at least one hepatobiliary abnormality。
  • 4/10 with bilirubin data were elevated。
  • 6/9 with GGT data were elevated。
  • 5/15 presented for diseases unrelated to hepatobiliary disease。
  • No cases had biliary obstruction or abnormal gallbladder size.

Diagnostic Pitfalls

Mucocele mimic

Adenoma with irregular wall thickening was called immature mucocele。

Debris mimic

NEC wall thickening with no reported Doppler flow was interpreted as organized debris。

Hepatic mass mimic

Large NEC effaced the gallbladder lumen and was mislocalized as hepatic mass。

Subclinical lesion

Some tumors were found during unrelated workup or routine monitoring。

Negative Doppler is not exclusionary

Doppler sensitivity depends on settings, depth, mode, machine, and blood-flow velocity. A fixed tissue-like lesion with no detected flow still deserves suspicion and further evaluation.

影像圖例｜Figures

Fig. 1 — Vascular sessile neuroendocrine carcinoma

中文：A：一隻診斷為 neuroendocrine carcinoma 犬的矢狀面超音波影像。腫塊呈均質高回音、sessile 形態，起源於膽囊背側壁，且沒有合併其他部位的膽囊壁增厚。腫塊最大徑 1.7 cm。B：同一隻犬的橫切面超音波影像。Color Doppler 顯示腫塊內部具有血流訊號，可協助將腫塊與無血流的膽囊 sludge 區分。

English: A, Sagittal ultrasonographic image of a dog diagnosed with neuroendocrine carcinoma obtained with an available ultrasound system (Logiq S8 Vet, GE, Boston MA) and an 10-MHz microconvex transducer. The mass is homogeneously hyperechoic, sessile in shape, arises from the dorsal gallbladder wall, and has no concurrent gallbladder wall thickening. The mass measures 1.7 cm in greatest dimension. B, Transverse ultrasonographic image of the same dog obtained with an available ultrasound system (Philips Logiq S8 Vet, GE, Boston MA) and a 10-MHz microconvex transducer. Interrogation with color Doppler shows vascularity within the mass, differentiating the mass from avascular gallbladder “sludge”.

Fig. 2 — Diffuse wall thickening pattern of neuroendocrine carcinoma

中文：一隻診斷為 neuroendocrine carcinoma 犬的橫切面超音波影像。可見均質高回音、瀰漫且規則的膽囊壁增厚，最大厚度達 1.29 cm。此圖強調 gallbladder neoplasia 不一定形成明顯腔內腫塊，也可能只表現為 diffuse wall thickening。

English: Transverse ultrasonographic image of a dog diagnosed with neuroendocrine carcinoma obtained with an available ultrasound system (Philips Epic 7G, GE, Boston MA) and an 8-MHz microconvex transducer. There is homogeneously hyperechoic diffuse, regular gallbladder wall thickening measuring up to 1.29 cm in greatest thickness.

Fig. 3 — Neuroendocrine carcinoma filling the entire gallbladder lumen

中文：一隻診斷為 neuroendocrine carcinoma 犬的矢狀面超音波影像。腫塊呈不均質高回音，佔據整個膽囊腔，最大徑 4.5 cm。原始檢查中此病灶曾因幾乎完全取代膽囊腔而被誤認為 hepatic mass。

English: Sagittal ultrasonographic image of a dog diagnosed with neuroendocrine carcinoma obtained with an available ultrasound system (Philips Epic 7G, GE, Boston MA) and an 8-MHz microconvex transducer. The mass is heterogeneously hyperechoic and occupies the entire gallbladder lumen, measuring 4.5 cm in greatest dimension.

Fig. 4 — Adenoma mimicking an immature mucocele

中文：一隻診斷為 adenoma 犬的橫切面超音波影像。膽囊壁呈不規則增厚且為不均質高回音，最大厚度 0.2 cm。執行檢查的超音波醫師最初將此病灶誤診為 immature mucocele。

English: Transverse ultrasonographic image of a dog diagnosed with adenoma obtained with an available ultrasound system (Philips iU22, GE, Boston MA) and an 8-MHz microconvex transducer. The gallbladder has an irregularly thickened, heterogeneously hyperechoic wall that measures up to 0.2 cm. The neoplasia was misdiagnosed by the performing ultrasonographer as an immature mucocele.

Fig. 5 — Extrahepatic cholangiocellular carcinoma in a cat

中文：一隻診斷為 extrahepatic cholangiocellular carcinoma 貓的矢狀面超音波影像。腫塊呈均質高回音、sessile 形態，幾乎佔據整個膽囊腔，並伴隨膽囊壁增厚。

English: Sagittal ultrasonographic image of a cat diagnosed with extrahepatic cholangiocellular carcinoma obtained with an available ultrasound system (Philips iU22, GE, Boston MA) and an 8-MHz microconvex transducer. The mass is homogeneously hyperechoic, sessile in shape, occupies nearly the entire lumen, and has concurrent gallbladder wall thickening.

Clinical Application

Recommended impression

A sessile tissue-like lesion arises from the gallbladder wall and demonstrates internal Doppler vascularity. These findings support a true gallbladder mass and raise concern for gallbladder neoplasia. The sonographic appearance is not specific for histologic type; tissue diagnosis and complete staging are recommended.

Wall-only pattern

Focal 或 diffuse gallbladder wall thickening 不能只用 inflammation、edema 或 mucocele 解釋；若有 persistent tissue-like abnormality，應把 neoplasia 放入 differential。

Bottom line

最值得記住的不是某個腫瘤長什麼樣，而是：膽囊腫瘤的 appearance 很多變，sessile + vascularity 最有幫助，wall-only tumor 不能漏掉。
